title: Credential ROI Suite
description: Compare bootcamp, degree, and certification ROI using BLS earnings data. Models NPV, payback period, opportunity cost, and salary premium with an AP2 handoff to the Graduate School ROI Comparator.
data_vintage: BLS OEWS May 2023 (16 SOC codes) · CIRR/SwitchUp 2023 bootcamp benchmarks · NCES IPEDS 2022-23 tuition tiers · Q4 2024 exam fee schedules (15 certifications)
regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) May 2023 — bls.gov/oes
NCES Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) 2022-23 — nces.ed.gov/ipeds
SwitchUp Bootcamp Reviews and Data 2023 — switchup.org
AWS, CompTIA, PMI, AICPA/NASBA, ISACA exam fee schedules Q4 2024

input_schema.roleKey: string — BLS SOC role key (e.g. software_dev, data_analyst)
input_schema.programCost: number — total direct program cost in USD
input_schema.durationYears: number — program duration in years (0 for certs)
input_schema.currentSalary: number — current annual salary in USD
input_schema.postSalary: number — expected post-credential annual salary in USD
input_schema.annualRenewal: number — annual renewal/maintenance cost in USD (certs only)

output_schema.totalDirectCost: number — direct program cost in USD
output_schema.oppCost: number — opportunity cost (foregone salary during study) in USD
output_schema.totalInvestment: number — direct cost + opportunity cost in USD
output_schema.annualPremium: number — salary increase post-credential in USD/yr
output_schema.netPremium: number — annualPremium minus annualRenewal in USD/yr
output_schema.npv: number — net present value over career horizon in USD
output_schema.paybackYears: number | null — simple payback period in years (null if beyond horizon)
output_schema.tenYrGain: number — approximate net financial gain over 10 years in USD

mcp_tool_definition.name: credential_roi_suite
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model ROI, NPV, and payback period for bootcamp, degree, or certification credentials using BLS earnings benchmarks. Exports AP2 credential_roi_evaluation for downstream use by AL-26 Graduate School ROI Comparator.
